#include <assert.h>

    TS_PACKAlefHandle config_handle = ts_pack_process_config_from_json("{\"language\":\"wgsl\"}");
    TS_PACKAlefHandle result = ts_pack_process("@vertex fn main() -> @builtin(position) vec4f { return vec4f(); }", config_handle);
